spec2def(cryptext.dll cryptext.spec)

# cryptext.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/cryptext-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(cryptext_shims OBJECT cryptext.c)
target_link_libraries(cryptext_shims PRIVATE uuid libcryptui libcrypt32 libuser32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
target_compile_definitions(cryptext_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
add_cargo_module(cryptext cryptext-cargo cryptext.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS cryptext_shims psdk uuid_sources)
